labels.name: Dorsal horn
labels.function: Receives and relays incoming sensory information

labels.name: Ventral horn
labels.function: Cell bodies of somatic motor neurons to skeletal muscle

labels.name: Lateral horn
labels.function: Preganglionic sympathetic neurons, present only at T1-L2

labels.name: Central canal
labels.function: Narrow CSF-filled space lined by ependymal cells

labels.name: Anterior white commissure
labels.function: Band where fibers decussate to the opposite side

labels.name: Dorsal columns
labels.function: Fine touch, vibration and conscious proprioception

labels.name: Lateral corticospinal tract
labels.function: Descending pathway for voluntary skeletal muscle movement

labels.name: Spinothalamic tract
labels.function: Ascending pathway for pain and temperature

labels.name: Dorsal root
labels.function: Brings sensory fibers into the cord

labels.name: Dorsal root ganglion
labels.function: Holds the cell bodies of primary sensory neurons

labels.name: Ventral root
labels.function: Carries motor and preganglionic autonomic axons out

labels.name: Spinal nerve
labels.function: Mixed nerve that divides into dorsal and ventral rami

labels.name: Conus medullaris
labels.function: Tapered end of the cord at about L1-L2 in adults

labels.name: Cauda equina
labels.function: Lumbar and sacral roots descending below the cord's end

labels.name: Lumbar cistern
labels.function: CSF-filled enlargement sampled at L3-L4 or L4-L5

labels.name: Dura mater
labels.function: Outermost meninx; puncture can cause a CSF-leak headache

labels.name: Arachnoid mater
labels.function: Middle meninx; CSF lies just deep to it

labels.name: Epidural space
labels.function: Fat-filled space where labor anesthetic is injected

labels.name: Ligamentum flavum
labels.function: Last ligament the needle crosses before the canal

labels.name: Interspinous ligament
labels.function: Second ligament pierced, between adjacent posterior projections

labels.name: Supraspinous ligament
labels.function: First ligament pierced, running along the posterior tips
